answers.unknowns: whether old verify records need a migration shim beyond reading them as one closed round

answers.could_break: existing plans with one-round verify records must stay readable; gate refusal text is parsed by inspect and regressions; approval fingerprint logic must not confuse plan approval with build approval; shipped checkpoint is terminal so SHIP.md must be written in the same step
answers.existing_capability: review rounds already carry findings with open/fixed/rejected and block the gate; build_report.py already renders BUILD.md from receipts; plan approval already records a reply and fingerprint
answers.owner: build_steps.py owns record validation and gate errors; plan_state.py owns approvals and checkpoints; build_report.py owns generated reports; plan_parser.py owns the state block

decisions.decision: verify findings as rounds with the review shape, three-round cap
decisions.rejected: single findings list without rounds: loses the per-round packet binding

decisions.decision: BUILD.md approval and SHIP.md inside this feature
decisions.rejected: separate features: two more plan cycles for small changes in the same owners

decisions.decision: BUILD.md approval = plain chat yes recorded by approve-build
decisions.rejected: signed reply or second reviewer: ceremony without a threat

decisions.decision: no S-n.md files, JSON receipts stay the only record
decisions.rejected: generated per-slice markdown: duplicate of receipts

decisions.decision: SHIP.md generated from state, never hand-written

axes.actors: builder recording verify rounds; verifier subagent; user approving BUILD.md; he-ship reading SHIP.md
axes.data-lifecycle: rounds live in build-steps.json bound to the tree; build_approval clears on tree change; SHIP.md generated once at shipped and terminal state stays immutable
axes.delivery-form: repository scripts and skill text only; no change for other wired repositories except the new commands
axes.empty-error-retry: round with no findings closes the loop; fourth round refused; missing packet refused; approve-build on a non-green plan refused; shipped checkpoint without SHA/URL refused
axes.rollout-rollback: revert commits; old records read as one closed round

answers.thinnest_path: S-1 alone makes a verifier finding block the gate and loop back, which is the outcome's core; S-2 and S-3 add the two new gates
